title: Kubernetes: clusters
description: Each Kubernetes environment at a glance: nodes, pods, restarts, and CPU and memory requested and used. From kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor and the kubelet, as Grafana's Kubernetes monitoring chart and Alloy send them.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.description: An environment is a Kubernetes cluster, or any machines, that send to this Grafana under one name: the cluster label Alloy sets, which is the name given in the Telopi portal.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is true, and those whose is false or unknown: those take no new pods.

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: Pods running, and pods not running: waiting to be scheduled or started, failed, or on a node that stopped reporting.

panels.title: Restarts, last hour
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour. A few after a deploy are normal; a steady count is a crash loop.

panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: CPU that running and pending pods request, of what the nodes can allocate. Near 100%, new pods stay pending.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"})) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Memory that running and pending pods request, of what the nodes can allocate.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"})) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: CPU the containers use, of what the nodes can allocate. Needs cAdvisor's metrics; empty with kube-state-metrics alone.

panels.title: CPU: used, requested, allocatable
panels.description: In cores. Used needs cAdvisor's metrics.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

panels.title: Memory: used, requested, allocatable
panels.description: Used is the containers' working set, what the kernel counts against a limit. Needs cAdvisor's metrics.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: How many pods are in each phase.

panels.title: Containers that cannot start
panels.description: Containers waiting for a reason that needs a look: crash-looping, an image that cannot be pulled, a missing secret or config.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$environment", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerConfigError|CreateContainerError|InvalidImageName"}) > 0

defaults.noValue: Nothing to look at: every container started.

panels.title: Containers last stopped by an error
panels.description: Containers whose last run ended out of memory (OOMKilled) or with an error, and how often each restarted.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$environment", reason=~"OOMKilled|Error|ContainerCannotRun"} > 0) * on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$environment"})

defaults.noValue: None: no container stopped on an error.

panels.title: Namespaces
panels.description: Each namespace now. CPU in cores; used needs cAdvisor's metrics. Open one to see its workloads.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

sum by (cluster, namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Each node now: whether it is ready, what it can allocate, and how much of that running and pending pods request.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"})) / max by (cluster, node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$environment", resource="cpu"})

sum by (cluster, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase=~"Pending|Running"})) / max by (cluster, node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$environment", resource="memory"})

sum by (cluster, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$environment"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", phase="Running"}))

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Each persistent volume claim that a running pod mounts, as the kubelet measures it. Empty without the kubelet's metrics.
